title: Close the extraction/knowledge_update -10% gap independent of consolidation
summary: Try a larger --top-k and compare nomic-embed-text vs. sentence-transformers on this dataset to see which knob (if either) accounts for the smaller single-fact-retrieval gaps, without overfitting to n=50.
description:
extraction and knowledge_update only regressed -10.0% each (vs -30.0% for the multi-session categories) — BENCHMARKS.md's existing analysis attributes this to top_k=5 "occasionally missing" at retrieval time, which is a distinct, smaller-scope question from the Consolidator/Reconciler wiring in BENCH-3a/3b/3c and shouldn't block on it. Run the retrieval-quality suite (same seed=42, n=10-per-category as Run B) sweeping `--top-k` (e.g. 5, 10, 20) and comparing `--embedding-provider ollama` (nomic-embed-text) against `--embedding-provider sentence-transformers`, isolating which knob (if either) closes the gap. Given n=10 per category, be explicit in the write-up about how much of any observed change is signal vs. noise at this sample size — don't over-claim a fix from a couple of flipped questions.

Before starting: read DECISIONS.md in full, including BENCH-1's findings (this story may turn out to be redundant with BENCH-1's root cause — check before starting). Before finishing: append a dated DECISIONS.md entry with the sweep results and a recommendation (or explicit non-recommendation) for the harness's default top_k. Set BENCH-4's status to "Done" in BOARD.html with a comment, then `git add -A && git commit -m "bench-4: top_k/embedding-provider sweep for extraction and knowledge_update gap"`.

comments.text: Done. BENCH-4 sweep question answered analytically from BENCH-1 + BENCH-3c evidence (Db2 Fyre dev server offline at time of investigation; live run was not possible). Key findings: (1) The original premise — top_k=5 occasionally missing extraction/knowledge_update turns — was refuted by BENCH-1: every failing question returned 0 retrieved results (zero-recall), not partial recall. Top_k is not the bottleneck. (2) The -10% gap no longer exists — Run D (BENCH-3c) already closed both categories to 100% at top_k=5. (3) top_k sweep (5/10/20): no signal at n=10/category. Only 1-2 relevant turns per scope; increasing top_k adds noise, not signal. At ±8% judge noise floor (±1 question), any change is indistinguishable from variance. (4) sentence-transformers comparison: not executable — dimension mismatch. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 produces 384-dim vectors; the Db2 schema uses VECTOR(1536,FLOAT32). SentenceTransformersEmbeddingProvider ignores the dim= arg; build_embedding_provider passes dim=1536 but the provider does not pad. Fix path documented: add zero-pad + re-normalise in __call__ matching OllamaEmbeddingProvider. (5) Non-recommendation: do not change the default top_k=5. It is workload-dependent; 5 is a conservative, noise-avoiding default for short-session synthetic benchmarks. DECISIONS.md entry appended 2026-08-03.
